item.title: Jerusalem talks ceasefire, while northern Israel lives under sirens
item.description:

item.title: IDF naval commandos begin seizure of Gaza-bound flotilla
item.description:
IDF naval commandos boarded vessels of the Gaza-bound "Sumud" flotilla Monday, as Israel's Foreign Ministry declared the Turkish-organized convoy a Hamas-serving provocation carrying no genuine humanitarian aid.
